verdict.rationale: First-party docs show Gemini in BigQuery lets users find, join, query and visualize table assets in natural language. Conversational analytics supports natural-language conversations with data, including configurable data agents and newer question types such as market basket analysis. Data canvas and NL-to-SQL/Python generation round out NL-driven analysis. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of NL quality and accuracy, and evidence that NL commands extend beyond analysis to operational tasks (dataset creation, loading, admin).
